answers.brief_reasoning: This is a standard procedure for timing a mass on a spring.
answers.final_answer: Equipment: a spring hung from a clamp stand, a set of known masses (or a mass hanger), a balance and a stopwatch. Procedure: (1) Hang a known mass m (measured on the balance) on the spring. (2) Pull it down a small distance and release it so it oscillates vertically.
